description: This file defines API routes for managing videos using FastAPI. It includes endpoints to list videos, retrieve metadata for a specific video, and stream video content with HTTP range support.

methods.name: Any list_videos(video_service: VideoService = Depends(get_video_service))
methods.description: Returns a list of all available videos' metadata.

methods.name: Any get_video(video_id: int, video_service: VideoService = Depends(get_video_service))
methods.description: Returns metadata for a specific video identified by its ID.

methods.name: stream_video(video_id: int, request: Request, video_service: VideoService = Depends(get_video_service))
methods.description: Streams the content of a video with support for HTTP Range requests.
